sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
purpose: Use MariaDB-style relational discipline to organize LuHm repos and pipeline state. This is a schema/query design model, not a claim that GitHub or OpenAI literally are SQL databases.

relationalAnalogy.foreignKeys: sourceRef taskId scopeId providerId artifactId deploymentId repoId
relationalAnalogy.views: small read models for chat UI, status panels and dashboards
relationalAnalogy.storedProcedures: bounded deterministic tools and workflow actions
relationalAnalogy.blobs: Google Drive durable files, referenced by digest and logical pointer

repoRegistry.purpose: repo responsibility, canonical branch, compatibility role and lifecycle

agentRegistry.purpose: Lum, goddess, Oni and deterministic worker identities

compatibilityRegistry.purpose: MCP, JSON manifests, RSS/event projections, adapters and workflow glue

taskLedger.purpose: bounded work envelopes linked to sourceRef and scopeId

evidenceLedger.purpose: observed and proven receipts linked to exact source, task and scope

artifactRegistry.purpose: metadata, hashes and Drive pointers only

deploymentRegistry.purpose: Render, Android, Cloudflare and future runtime targets

decisionLedger.purpose: Professor corrections, Crown decisions and supersession

systemMapping.github: source + compatibility layer + remote forge + receipt ledger
